job-description: I am looking for an interesting technical challenge in an ambitious team focused on modern technologies, microservices architecture, and software craftsmanship (clean code, refactoring...).
about-content: With a Master's degree in computer science and over 4 years' professional experience, including 2 years of apprenticeship.
education-master-content: 2nd-year specialization in Information Technology and Web (TIW)
professional-experience-basf-content:
2-year apprenticeship followed by 1.5-year fixed-term contract and 1.5-year freelancing.

  • Independent work on conception and development of web applications and relational databases for complex agricultural business processes.
  • Recruitment and technical supervision of apprentices who succeeded me. Migration from an old PHP legacy monolith to a TypeScript Next.js/PostgreSQL stack.
  • Agile development and continuous delivery, communicating directly with French and German end users (agronomists).
  • Provided advice to teams responsible for international process digitalization, actively participated in writing specifications, and provided technical support to the contracted IT development company in an international context.
  • Main achievements: development and maintenance of multiple web applications of different stacks, experience of working autonomously in direct collaboration with international users, recruitment and supervision of apprentices in a context of technological transition that I myself initiated, skills in consulting, writing specifications and technical support for a service provider company.
professional-experience-jae-content:
3-month intership followed by a 2-month fixed-term contract

  • Internship focused on Business Intelligence: consolidation of relational databases and data visualization/reporting using Tableau.
  • Fixed-term contract focused on web development using PHP/JavaScript/MySQL.
  • Main achievements: creation and manipulation of databases in a business intelligence context, first steps in maintaining web applications in production.
professional-experience-mcdo-content:
Part-time student job, 12 hours per week on weekends, following a summer fixed-term contract of 25 hours per week in 2017

  • Prepared food orders in accordance with current standards.
  • Executed restaurant closing procedures, including dismantling, cleaning, and reassembling of restaurant equipment.
  • Main achievements: demonstrated initiative and organizational skills, worked autonomously, effectively collaborated in a team, managed stress, and adhered to strict guidelines and standards.
resume-description: Software engineer with over 4 years' experience in developing internal web applications based on the needs of non-technical users facing complex business processes.
skills-description:
My jack-of-all-trades profile enables me to learn and adapt to a new stack quickly and without apprehension.

My current favorite stack: Typescript + Next.js (React) + Material UI + PostgreSQL + Gitlab + Docker/Kubernetes.
portfolio-description: Discover a non-exhaustive extract of my personal and student projects.
portfolio-sport-description: Web application for sports training management. The most complete side project I've developed for my friends and myself to manage our weightlifting workouts. Developed in Typescript (React/Express) and PostgreSQL.
portfolio-next-template-description: Next template with basic custom Material UI components including data table, fields...
portfolio-recipes-description: Web application for sharing recipes. My first PHP project initially developed for family use, then used as a refactoring base during the 'Application Lifecycle' course in university. Developed in PHP/MySQL.
portfolio-the-periodic-table-nft-descrip: The Periodic Table of Element as NFT. Developed with a friend during our Master's degree between two exams. Developed in HTML/CSS/JS.
portfolio-click-the-cookie-description: Cookie clicker game in space... Developed in HTML/CSS/JS on a rainy Sunday...
portfolio-get-out-of-the-dungeon-descrip: Interactive book where you are the hero (French only). One of my first JavaScript projects to understand how JSON files and Ajax requests work. Developed in HTML/CSS/JS
portfolio-the-price-is-right-description: The Price is Right game. Developed in HTML/CSS/JS.
portfolio-snake-description: First JavaScript project. I think there's no need to introduce the Snake game. Developed in HTML/CSS/JS.
portfolio-netreality-description: Fictional website fighting for net neutrality, as part of an English course. Developed in HTML/CSS.
portfolio-le-mauvais-centre-description: Fictional static e-commerce website. My first web project in university to practice HTML/CSS only. The code and the interface are hideous, but it's always fun to see how much you've improved.
interests-description: My current interests and anything that might occupy my free time.
interests-vr-description: I recently acquired a VR headset and am enjoying discovering the different experiences available. I can't wait to see how this technology evolves over the next few years. I'm also planning to learn VR game development.
interests-deno-description: I'm interested in Deno, a runtime environment for JavaScript and TypeScript. Deno was created by Ryan Dahl, the creator of Node.js, to correct design errors in Node.js.
interests-finary-description: Finary is a wealth management application that allows you to centralize all your assets. I recently discovered this app and its founder, Mounir Laggoune, inspired me with his background and vision. His recently published book <q>Investir pour être libre</q> made me realize how important it is to take care of your personal finances from an early age.
interests-cryptos-description: Somewhat belatedly, I am starting to get interested in the cryptocurrency market and how it works
interests-mfs24-description: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is a flight simulation that reproduces the whole world and whose graphics have never been so realistic (if your PC allows it): 4K Trailer
interests-watches-description: Ever since I was a kid, I've always worn a watch, beginning by a simple Geonaute from Decathlon. Recently, I've become really interested in the world of horology, its history and, more specifically, automatic watches and how they work.
interests-golang-description: To open myself up to something other than the JavaScript ecosystem, I got interested and started learning Go, which is a compiled and concurrent programming language inspired by C and Pascal developed by Google.
